title: "How much progress have I made?" traces the path from the start
origin: Spec #8 (coach memory), part 2: progress traces the whole path back to the start, accurately

history.text: Hey Dana! 15 pages of Atomic Habits on the couch at 8.

plan.reason: Fifteen pages keeps the book moving without eating the evening.

earlier_goals.reason: kept scrolling in bed; wants to read at night instead of fighting her phone

facts.text: Started at 5 pages because she hadn't read a book in two years
Moved up to 10 pages after a full week without a miss
Moved up to 15 pages; said 10 felt easy now

daily.title: Switched from bedtime to reading
daily.summary: Bedtime goal kept losing to her phone; switched to reading.
daily.body: Dana said she kept scrolling in bed and wanted to read at night instead. Switched goals; new plan of 5 pages a night.

daily.title: First full week
daily.summary: Seven nights of 5 pages, no misses.
daily.body: Dana finished her first week without a miss.

daily.title: Up to 15 pages
daily.body: Said 10 pages felt easy; plan changed to 15.

testerLines: honestly how much progress have I actually made since I started with you?
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a progress question three weeks in.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH traces the whole path accurately from the start: she began on a bedtime goal about three weeks ago, switched to reading because she kept scrolling in bed, started at 5 pages a night, moved to 10 after a clean week, and now 15. It mentions her recent run of done days (one reduced) without inventing numbers or dates that aren't in memory, and keeps it to a short text or two.
